components.name: Create
components.element:
{((translate, locales) => <Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.general')}>
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required(), useUniqId()]}/>
   <TranslatableInputs locales={locales.map(({locale}) => locale)}>
    <TextInput source="title"/>
    <Component resource="page" name="RichInput" source="body"/>
   </TranslatableInputs>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.tags')}>
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.page.tags.${tag}`)}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>)(useTranslate(), useLocales())}

components.name: Edit
components.element:
{((translate, locales) => <Edit>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.general')}>
   <Labeled>
    <FunctionField source="updatedAt" render={() => <><DateField showTime source="updatedAt"/> <TextField source="updatedBy"/></>}/>
   </Labeled>
   <TranslatableInputs locales={locales.map(({locale}) => locale)}>
    <TextInput source="title"/>
    <Component resource="page" name="RichInput" source="body"/>
   </TranslatableInputs>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.tags')}>
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.page.tags.${tag}`)}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Edit>)(useTranslate(), useLocales())}

components.name: List
components.element:
{((locale, translate) => <List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <ParseInput component={TextInput} source="title" parse={value => `{value: Like('%${value}%')}`}/>,
 <ParseInput component={SelectInput} source="tags" parse={value => `{name: '${value}'}`} choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.page.tags.${tag}`)}))} label={translate('resources.page.tabs.tags')}/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={({id}) =>
   <Link to={`/${id}`}>{id}</Link>
  }/>
  <TextField source={`title.${locale}`} label={translate('resources.page.fields.title')}/>
  <ArrayField source="tags" label={translate('resources.page.tabs.tags')}>
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <FunctionField render={({name}) => <Chip size="small" label={translate(`resources.page.tags.${name}`)}/>}/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>)(useLocale(), useTranslate())}

components.name: Menu
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="menu">
 {content =>
  <List>
   {content.map(({id, title}) =>
    <ListItem key={id}>
      <ListItemButton component={Link} to={`/${id}`}>
        <ListItemText primary={title}/>
      </ListItemButton>
    </ListItem>
   )}
  </List>
 }
</Content>

components.name: One
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="one" id={props.id}>
 {({title, code}) =>
  (() => <Parser code={code}/>)(title && (document.title = title))
 }
</Content>

components.name: RichInput
components.element:
{(([value, setValue], translate, ref, {source}) =>
  <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
    <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider' }}>
      <Tabs value={value} onChange={(e, v) => setValue(v)}>
        <Tab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.editor')} />
        <Tab label={translate('resources.page.tabs.source')} />
      </Tabs>
    </Box>
    <Box hidden={!value}>
      <CodeInput source={source} inputProps={{ref}} label="" />
      <ImagesInput source={source} codeRef={ref} />
    </Box>
    <Box hidden={!!value}>
      <RichInput
        label={false}
        source={source}
        toolbar={
          <RichTextInputToolbar>
            <LevelSelect />
            <FormatButtons />
            <ColorButtons />
            <AlignmentButtons />
            <ListButtons />
            <LinkButtons />
            <QuoteButtons />
            <ClearButtons />
            <ToggleButtonGroup>
              <ImageButtons />
              <ImagesButton source={source} title="ra.tiptap.images">
                <SvgIcon>
                  <path d="M22 16V4c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2H8c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v12c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h12c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2m-11-4 2.03 2.71L16 11l4 5H8zM2 6v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14v-2H4V6z" />
                </SvgIcon>
              </ImagesButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
            <ToggleButtonGroup>
              <ComponentButton
                title="ra.tiptap.menu"
                resource="page"
                name="Menu"
              >
                <SvgIcon>
                  <path d="M16 3H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V8zM7 7h5v2H7zm10 10H7v-2h10zm0-4H7v-2h10zm-2-4V5l4 4z" />
                </SvgIcon>
              </ComponentButton>
              <IdComponentButton
                title="ra.tiptap.page"
                resource="page"
                name="One"
              >
                <SvgIcon>
                  <path d="M19 3H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2m-5 14H7v-2h7zm3-4H7v-2h10zm0-4H7V7h10z" />
                </SvgIcon>
              </IdComponentButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
          </RichTextInputToolbar>
        }
      />
    </Box>
  </Box>
)(useState(0), useTranslate(), useRef(), props)}
